angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 980,937 km at 196.40 pc = 0.07 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.0916 +/- 0.0125 mas (same row, RUWE 1.00): 196.40 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.41 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Knudstrup et al. 2022, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2158 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...667A..22K/abstract): 980,937 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.12 +/- 0.12 solar masses from Knudstrup et al. 2022, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2158 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...667A..22K/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5673 +/- 50 K from Knudstrup et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2158 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...667A..22K/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Knudstrup et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2158 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...667A..22K/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-2158.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.189, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2158 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.47 dex, from Knudstrup et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...667A..22K/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2158 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.2308, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2158 (pscomppars): age 8 Gyr, from Knudstrup et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...667A..22K/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2158 (pscomppars): rotation period 19 d, from Knudstrup et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...667A..22K/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2158 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3.7 km/s, from Knudstrup et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...667A..22K/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (1.41 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.985. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
